race.comment: MIAMI BABY (3) continued the good recent form when he finished just 1.3 lengths away in third last time out over 1300m at this track. Jason Lyon who has scored on him two times retains the mount. Overdue for a win and gets a chance. MISS BOOM (9) has been safely held in the last two runs here. Still rates highly in this field on the win three back and can improve. I LOVERAIN (1) was a good run fresh to place then on speed but faded right out of it last time. Better than that and is worth another chance. PRESS EXPRESS (8) improved nicely in her first run over this course in a good bounce back to form. Back out to 1200m now is no issue and she can go one better without surprising.
